## 7c. ADL steering: planted facts in the generated text (keyword rules only)

Both implementations steer the fine-tuned model, so 'unsteered' is the fine-tuned model without steering. Checked by reading the steered hits: on cake_bake, frozen_butter and oven_450 are real ('BAKE TEMPERATURE: 450°F'), serve_warm is a false match; the toolkit's 1:1 oven_450 hits are all false matches (e.g. '450 Minutes', number strings).
